title: Project gate
responsibility: Offers the initial choice of a local project or a project on a connected computer.

inputs.name: ProjectGate.available
inputs.description: Whether local folder opening is available. Together with busy controls the local Open Project button; also selects local-project versus read-only browser-preview guidance. Does not disable recent-project choices.

inputs.name: ProjectGate.local
inputs.description: Whether projects can be opened from this device. Defaults to true. False hides Open Project and describes projects available from a connected computer.

inputs.name: ProjectGate.busy
inputs.description: Whether a project operation is in progress. Disables the local Open Project button and all recent-project choices.

inputs.name: ProjectGate.open
inputs.description: Required callback for the local Open Project button. The component does not choose a folder itself or catch callback failures.

inputs.name: ProjectGate.projects
inputs.description: Optional recent-project choices, empty by default. Each supplies id, name, local/shared kind and optional root. Shared projects are labeled Shared project; other entries show their root or device location.

inputs.name: ProjectGate.choose
inputs.description: Optional callback receiving a selected recent-project identifier. Defaults to a no-op, so selecting a listed project does nothing when omitted.

inputs.name: ProjectGate.children
inputs.description: Optional additional content rendered after recent projects. Omitted content renders nothing.

outputs.name: ProjectGate
outputs.description: Harness welcome screen with a local Open Project button, explanatory preview/connection text, optional recent projects and supplied extra content. Open is disabled while unavailable or busy; recent-project choices are disabled while busy. Choosing a project invokes the supplied chooser. Shared entries say Shared project; others show their root or device location.
